title: Cub Scout adventure categories
description: How an adventure counts toward a Cub Scout rank. A rank is earned by completing all six of its required adventures plus any two electives. The authoritative grouping for a given rank is that rank's own requirement-set; this vocabulary names the groups and is single-valued on adventure.category.

terms.label: Required
terms.description: One of the six adventures every Scout must complete to earn the rank. Includes the rank's Bobcat adventure.

terms.label: Elective
terms.description: Optional adventure; any two count toward the rank, and a Scout may complete as many as they wish.

terms.label: Special Elective
terms.description: Elective adventure that may only be completed at an approved event run by a qualified instructor. Covers the shooting-sports adventures (Archery, BB Guns, Slingshot), whose requirements are not published online.
